content:
Represent \(x\) as a 3-digit string \(abc\) with leading zeros. Then  
\[
999-x=(9-a)(9-b)(9-c).
\]
Each column contributes a complementary pair \(\{d,9-d\}\), one of
\[
\{0,9\},\{1,8\},\{2,7\},\{3,6\},\{4,5\}.
\]
For the whole sign to contain only two different digits, all three columns must use the same complementary pair.

There are 5 possible pairs, and for each pair each of the 3 columns has 2 choices, giving
\[
5\cdot 2^3=40.
\]

\[
\boxed{40}
\]
